brief.vibe: A dark trading desk console at 4 a.m.: phosphor green on graphite, monospace everywhere, numbers as the decoration, the tone of a machine that only reports what survived.
brief.hero: A left sidebar console (run clock, gates, routes) anchors every page; the hero is an oversized 48/48 counter in Schibsted Grotesk over a wall of wireframe survivor slabs on the right, the H1 and a prompt style text CTA sitting under the counter.
brief.type: Schibsted Grotesk headings with IBM Plex Mono body and UI; the set piece is the survivor counter that counts down as specifications die.
brief.palette: Dark graphite field, grey ladder of tones, one phosphor yellow green for the live and kept states and the purchase button.
brief.motion: Storytelling scroll where the 48 slabs die gate by gate, counters ticking in step with real load, terminal cursor prompts, calm and mechanical; no flourish anywhere.
brief.speech: H1 in two short sentences with a number led first clause; CTAs "Purchase a Plan / Purchase Research / Purchase Desk"; sections as wh-lead questions and noun phrases; blog titles as number led and myth negation; sober quantitative recorder voice, prompts marked with > .
brief.rhythm: Console sidebar plus a single content column of ledger like panels, each a framed terminal card; gates numbered 01 to 04 across the page.
